title: Agent registry with sponsor, purpose and permissions
objective: Every agent is registered with identity, sponsor, purpose, model/provider, tools and permissions
frameworks: NIST AI RMF GOVERN 1.6, 2.1; ISO 42001; OWASP ASI03
implementation_mechanism: Agent definitions in repository; registration required to obtain credentials
exception_handling: Exception via POL-01.05: approver independent of requester, compensating control, max 12 months; expired exception = control failure

title: Agent permissions enforced outside the model
objective: Agent capabilities limited by platform authorization (not prompts); grants continuously compared with definitions
frameworks: OWASP LLM06, ASI02; NIST AI RMF MAP 3.5
implementation_mechanism: Scoped workload identities; tool allowlists; diff of grants vs agent definition
exception_handling: Exception via POL-01.05: approver independent of requester, compensating control, max 12 months; expired exception = control failure

title: Untrusted-content isolation (prompt injection)
objective: Executions that ingest untrusted content cannot take consequential actions in the same execution
risk_addressed: Prompt injection leading to harmful actions
implementation_mechanism: Two-step architecture: read/analyze identity without write tools; consequential actions via separate authorized step
independence_requirement: Red team independent of agent builders
failure_response: Consequential tool unavailable in untrusted context
exception_handling: Exception via POL-01.05: approver independent of requester, compensating control, max 12 months; expired exception = control failure
known_limitations: Model-level defenses unreliable; architecture is the control

title: Agent action receipts and accountability

implementation_mechanism: Praxis execution records bound to authenticated identity; signed receipts
failure_response: Action without receipt rejected by consuming system
exception_handling: Exception via POL-01.05: approver independent of requester, compensating control, max 12 months; expired exception = control failure
known_limitations: Signed receipts not implemented (PC-19)

title: Agents cannot alter evidence or approve their own work

title: AI involvement disclosure and correction path
objective: Where AI materially contributes to an output a person relies on, that involvement is disclosed and the person has a correction and human escalation path
risk_addressed: Over-reliance on undisclosed AI output; uncorrectable errors
frameworks: Owner AIG-BC-016; NIST AI RMF MAP/MANAGE; EU AI Act Art. 50 (applicability undetermined)
implementation_mechanism: Disclosure marker on AI-assisted customer, auditor and policy outputs; correction request and human escalation workflow; user workflow tests

failure_response: AI-assisted outward output without disclosure blocked from publication

known_limitations: "Where appropriate" requires judgment; legal disclosure duties (EU AI Act Art. 50) undetermined

title: Parameterized data access only through the Strata boundary
objective: No dynamically constructed SQL; only the approved Strata adapter reaches the database; identifiers from fixed mappings
risk_addressed: SQL injection; bypass of data access controls
frameworks: Owner SBC-001/005; OWASP ASVS V5; CWE-89
implementation_mechanism: Strata typed operations; restricted DB credentials per adapter; AST/import checks forbidding raw command APIs and direct provider access; injection payload tests against a real test database
independence_requirement: Verifier credentials separate from implementer; technical verification is not organizational independence
failure_response: Forbidden construct fails the build; direct connection denied by credentials
exception_handling: Exception per POL-01.05 with elevated approval (owner decision 0D04); expired exception = control failure
known_limitations: Authorization logic, stored procedures and provider internals are outside the boundary; Strata capability to be verified (decision 0D0C)

title: Context-encoded rendering; no raw HTML sinks

exception_handling: Exception per POL-01.05 with elevated approval (owner decision 0D04); expired exception = control failure

title: Managed immutable evidence storage (custom ledger and anchoring deferred)
objective: Production evidence is held in managed storage under a compliance-mode retention lock in a trust domain separate from producers, so it cannot be altered or deleted before its retention period ends; completeness is shown by separate population reconciliation (CTL-ASR-003), not by the store.
risk_addressed: Evidence alteration or rollback by insiders
implementation_mechanism: Managed object storage with a compliance-mode retention lock in a separate trust domain, applied from the first production evidence (DF-ASR-2026-C002, accepted). The earlier hash-chained, externally anchored ledger design is deferred until a customer, auditor or regulator requirement is recorded.
independence_requirement: Storage administered outside the producing systems' principals; not organizationally independent while one owner administers all accounts
failure_response: Write by a non-collector principal or a delete/overwrite attempt is refused by the provider and alerted; integrity verification failure is an incident
exception_handling: Exception via POL-01.05: approver independent of requester, compensating control, max 12 months; expired exception = control failure
known_limitations: Integrity is not accuracy or completeness (see CTL-ASR-003). Provider-level trust; the single owner administering the cloud organization can close the account (BR-IAM-002, ODP-03).

implementation_mechanism: Money type in the financial kernel; property tests for rounding, overflow, allocation and FX
independence_requirement: Verifier credentials separate from implementer; technical verification is not organizational independence
exception_handling: Exception per POL-01.05 with elevated approval (owner decision 0D04); expired exception = control failure
known_limitations: Business rule choices for rounding need sponsor approval

title: Scheduled transactions revalidated at execution
objective: Recurring and scheduled financial transactions recheck funds, authority, eligibility and current rules at execution
risk_addressed: Stale authorization or eligibility executed later
implementation_mechanism: Execution-time revalidation in the scheduler; tests for changed circumstances and duplicate schedules
independence_requirement: Verifier credentials separate from implementer; technical verification is not organizational independence
exception_handling: Exception per POL-01.05 with elevated approval (owner decision 0D04); expired exception = control failure
known_limitations: Rules themselves may be wrong

title: Recoverability and controlled replay
objective: Synthetic histories can be restored and replayed, reconciled before release, preserving idempotency
risk_addressed: Unrecoverable or inconsistent financial state after outage or upgrade
implementation_mechanism: Restore-and-replay exercises on synthetic data; reconciliation gate before release
independence_requirement: Verifier credentials separate from implementer; technical verification is not organizational independence
exception_handling: Exception per POL-01.05 with elevated approval (owner decision 0D04); expired exception = control failure
known_limitations: Synthetic histories may miss production edge cases

title: Accountable assurance owner and deputy
objective: An accountable role for the security and assurance program (held by the owner) and an emergency delegate role are defined; individuals are designated when operationally necessary (DF-ASR-2026-0D10, ODP-04)
risk_addressed: Program drifts or stalls without accountable ownership
frameworks: TSC CC1.3; FTC Safeguards 314.4(a); CSF GV.RR; ISO 42001 5.3
implementation_mechanism: Owner designation recorded in policy model; appointment event
independence_requirement: Multiple-agent review (VAL-041); organizational independence not available (disclosed)
exception_handling: Exception via POL-01.05: approver independent of requester, compensating control, max 12 months; expired exception = control failure

title: Written policy set approved and versioned
objective: Policies POL-01..13 are approved by the approval authority, versioned, and generated from the structured policy model
risk_addressed: Policies absent, stale, or diverging between versions in use
frameworks: TSC CC5.3; CSF GV.PO; FTC Safeguards 314.4; ISO 27001 5.2
implementation_mechanism: F# policy model in protected repository; approval recorded as signed commit by approval authority; published hash
independence_requirement: Approval by authority other than drafter
failure_response: Unapproved policy not published; drift raises alert
exception_handling: Exception via POL-01.05: approver independent of requester, compensating control, max 12 months; expired exception = control failure

title: Unauthorized policy change detection
objective: Published policy and control definitions always match an approved version
risk_addressed: Silent weakening of policy or controls (by human or agent)
implementation_mechanism: CODEOWNERS/rulesets on policy repo require approval authority; published-hash vs approved-hash comparison; weakening-change classifier flags diffs that lower thresholds or remove controls
independence_requirement: Classifier is advisory; human approval decisive
failure_response: Restore approved version; incident if bypass
exception_handling: Exception via POL-01.05: approver independent of requester, compensating control, max 12 months; expired exception = control failure

title: Risk assessment and risk register
objective: Risks to objectives (security, privacy, financial integrity, fraud, AI, vendor, regulatory, assurance-system) are assessed and treated
frameworks: TSC CC3.1-CC3.4; FTC Safeguards 314.4(b); CSF GV.RM, ID.RA; ISO 42001 6.1
implementation_mechanism: Machine-readable risk register; review event; agents propose emerging risks, humans decide treatment
independence_requirement: Treatment decisions by the owner; multiple-agent review (VAL-041); external review only on a recorded trigger (DF-ASR-2026-0D0F)
failure_response: Overdue review escalates to approval authority
exception_handling: Exception via POL-01.05: approver independent of requester, compensating control, max 12 months; expired exception = control failure

title: Requirement register and applicability decisions
objective: Every obligation is recorded with applicability classification, reasoning and mapped controls; undetermined items are resolved by internal primary-source research and multiple-agent review with a prepared legal question; affected capability gated from activation; external advice only on a recorded trigger (DF-ASR-2026-0D0F, ODP-12)
implementation_mechanism: regulatory/requirements.csv + validator; open-question register
independence_requirement: Multiple-agent review of applicability judgments; undetermined items stay undetermined until resolved; internal research is never represented as legal opinion
failure_response: CI fails on unmapped or dangling requirements
exception_handling: Exception via POL-01.05: approver independent of requester, compensating control, max 12 months; expired exception = control failure

title: Regulatory change monitoring
objective: Changes to authoritative sources are detected and assessed against affected requirements, controls and policies
implementation_mechanism: Agent monitors source register URLs/feeds, opens review items with diff; human disposition
independence_requirement: Agent detection; human decision
exception_handling: Exception via POL-01.05: approver independent of requester, compensating control, max 12 months; expired exception = control failure

title: Exception and risk acceptance register
objective: Exceptions are recorded with scope, compensating control, expiry, requester and an independent approver; agents cannot approve
frameworks: TSC CC5.1; NIST AI RMF GOVERN
implementation_mechanism: Tutela-style exception engine: verified non-self approver, expiry, role check; expiry auto-converts to control failure
independence_requirement: Approver ≠ requester enforced by system
exception_handling: Exception via POL-01.05: approver independent of requester, compensating control, max 12 months; expired exception = control failure

title: Authority matrix enforced by systems
objective: Approval authorities are defined once (machine-readable) and consumed by repository rules and application authorization
risk_addressed: Approvals by unauthorized persons; inconsistent authority across systems
implementation_mechanism: Authority matrix in policy model compiled into rulesets, Ordo/Tutela roles, Unbound authorization
independence_requirement: Matrix changes approved by approval authority
exception_handling: Exception via POL-01.05: approver independent of requester, compensating control, max 12 months; expired exception = control failure

title: Segregation of duties (humans and agents)
objective: Incompatible duties are not held by one actor; where impractical, compensating review is recorded
risk_addressed: Single actor implements, validates and approves; fraud; error
frameworks: TSC CC5.1; NIST AI RMF MEASURE 1.3
implementation_mechanism: SoD matrix enforced: reviewer ≠ author, approver ≠ initiator, validator ≠ control operator; periodic role-combination analysis
independence_requirement: Small-team compensating controls via exceptions
exception_handling: Owner decision DF-ASR-2026-0D04: routine low-risk work proceeds under standing human authorization with a separate implementing agent, a technical verifier and an enforced release gate; material policy, privilege, financial-exception and verifier changes need elevated human approval; an action that needs organizational independence is blocked or redesigned (DF-ASR-2026-0D0F). Technical separation is not organizational independence.
known_limitations: With one human, full SoD is impossible; compensating controls are technical separation (VAL-040) and multiple-agent review (VAL-041), with actions that require organizational independence blocked or redesigned (DF-ASR-2026-0D0F; OQ-607/608).

title: Management review of assurance metrics
objective: Control health, failures, exceptions, risks, incidents and regulatory changes are reviewed and decisions recorded
risk_addressed: Failures noticed but not acted upon; compliance theater
frameworks: TSC CC4.2, CC2.2; FTC Safeguards 314.4(i); CSF GV.OV; ISO 42001 9.3
implementation_mechanism: Agent-prepared review pack from registers and evidence; human review and decisions recorded
independence_requirement: Pack prepared by agent; decisions human
exception_handling: Exception via POL-01.05: approver independent of requester, compensating control, max 12 months; expired exception = control failure

title: Control deficiency management
objective: Control failures and deficiencies are recorded, rated, remediated by deadline and retested
implementation_mechanism: Deficiency records in restricted tracker referenced by ID; SLA clocks
independence_requirement: Closure verified by someone other than remediator
exception_handling: Exception via POL-01.05: approver independent of requester, compensating control, max 12 months; expired exception = control failure

title: External claims reconciled to evidence
objective: Public, contractual and customer-facing security/compliance claims match control status and issued reports
risk_addressed: Misrepresentation (e.g. claiming SOC 2 compliance without a report)
implementation_mechanism: Claim lint over trust center, contracts, questionnaire answers against control status vocabulary
independence_requirement: Human approval of outbound claims
exception_handling: Exception via POL-01.05: approver independent of requester, compensating control, max 12 months; expired exception = control failure

title: Board/owner oversight independence
objective: Oversight of the program by a body or person able to challenge management
risk_addressed: No effective oversight in an owner-managed company
implementation_mechanism: Owner oversight with multiple-agent review; independent oversight is not available and is disclosed as a limitation (BR-GOV-017), reassessed before an observation period or a production risk acceptance (DF-ASR-2026-0D0F)
independence_requirement: Multiple-agent review (VAL-041); organizational independence not available (disclosed)
exception_handling: Exception via POL-01.05: approver independent of requester, compensating control, max 12 months; expired exception = control failure
known_limitations: Owner-managed entity: auditor may note limited independent oversight (OQ register)

title: Executable policy model with classified obligations
objective: One authoritative F# policy model whose obligations are classified (executable decision, configuration constraint, scheduled obligation, human judgment, external obligation), each with an explicit enforcement point, failure mode and reproducible decision
risk_addressed: Prose presented as enforcement; unknown enforcement points; irreproducible decisions
implementation_mechanism: F# policy model (policy-as-code specification); pure deciders with explicit inputs, outcomes, reasons and policy version; classification coverage check in CI; generated documents with drift detection
independence_requirement: Technical verifier separate from implementer; not organizational independence
failure_response: Unclassified obligation or missing enforcement point fails CI; generated-document drift fails CI
exception_handling: Exception per POL-01.05 with elevated approval (owner decision 0D04)
known_limitations: Classification is a human judgment; generation covers structured content only and non-generated text is linked, not verified

title: Human obligation tracking with completion evidence
objective: Every human obligation has an accountable role, due date, escalation and completion evidence; reminders are never treated as proof of completion
risk_addressed: Missed periodic duties hidden behind reminder systems
implementation_mechanism: Obligation register derived from the policy model; due-date clocks; escalation; completion requires an evidence reference
independence_requirement: Technical verifier separate from implementer; not organizational independence
failure_response: Overdue obligation escalates and is a control failure
exception_handling: Exception per POL-01.05 with elevated approval (owner decision 0D04)
known_limitations: Completion evidence quality still needs human review

title: Onboarding gate

known_limitations: Gate enforcement needs an HR/training system integrated with the IdP; none exists yet (OQ-802). Manual gate with recorded acknowledgement until then.

title: Security awareness and role training
objective: Personnel complete awareness training at start and on material change; role training before elevated access
risk_addressed: Personnel unaware of obligations and threats
frameworks: TSC CC2.2; FTC Safeguards 314.4(e); CSF PR.AT; NIST 800-53 AT
implementation_mechanism: Training platform completion events gate elevated roles
validation_frequency: per role change + annual content review
exception_handling: Exception via POL-01.05: approver independent of requester, compensating control, max 12 months; expired exception = control failure
known_limitations: Gate enforcement needs an HR/training system integrated with the IdP; none exists yet (OQ-802). Manual gate with recorded acknowledgement until then.

objective: Separation revokes all access (incl. owned service/agent identities) same day for privileged, one business day otherwise, verified across systems

exception_handling: Exception via POL-01.05: approver independent of requester, compensating control, max 12 months; expired exception = control failure

exception_handling: Exception via POL-01.05: approver independent of requester, compensating control, max 12 months; expired exception = control failure

exception_handling: Exception via POL-01.05: approver independent of requester, compensating control, max 12 months; expired exception = control failure

exception_handling: Exception via POL-01.05: approver independent of requester, compensating control, max 12 months; expired exception = control failure

exception_handling: Exception via POL-01.05: approver independent of requester, compensating control, max 12 months; expired exception = control failure
known_limitations: Fides delegates MFA to GitHub; GitHub org MFA requirement evidence must be captured (OQ-752)

title: Just-in-time privileged access
objective: No standing production admin; elevation time-bound, approved by a second person, logged
risk_addressed: Abuse or compromise of standing admin rights
implementation_mechanism: JIT elevation workflow in cloud IAM; approval by non-requester
independence_requirement: Approver ≠ requester
exception_handling: Exception via POL-01.05: approver independent of requester, compensating control, max 12 months; expired exception = control failure

Per ODP-03 (DF-ASR-2026-0D0F) architectural safeguards apply and no custodian is appointed; per ODP-04 (DF-ASR-2026-0D10) the delegate role is defined but not yet designated, so out-of-band alerting reaches only the owner until it is (residual risk RSK-065, BR-IAM-002).

title: Break-glass control
objective: Emergency accounts sealed, alert on use, reviewed within one business day
implementation_mechanism: Sealed credentials; use triggers alert to two people; review record
independence_requirement: Reviewer ≠ user
failure_response: Use allowed in emergency; unreviewed use = failure
exception_handling: Exception via POL-01.05: approver independent of requester, compensating control, max 12 months; expired exception = control failure
known_limitations: One-person interim: second-person approval and two-person alerting cannot operate. Per ODP-03 (DF-ASR-2026-0D0F) architectural safeguards apply and no custodian is appointed; per ODP-04 (DF-ASR-2026-0D10) the delegate role is defined but not yet designated, so out-of-band alerting reaches only the owner until it is (residual risk RSK-065, BR-IAM-002).

exception_handling: Exception via POL-01.05: approver independent of requester, compensating control, max 12 months; expired exception = control failure

title: Incident response plan and execution
objective: Incidents declared, triaged by severity, contained, eradicated, recovered and reviewed with tracked corrective actions
frameworks: TSC CC7.3-CC7.5; FTC Safeguards 314.4(h); CSF RS/RC; NIST 800-53 IR
implementation_mechanism: Append-only incident record with computed deadlines; post-incident review
